_comment: World placement for the unit regular prism, a frameless black triangular collimator, and the projection screen. Illumination is supplied only by light-source.json.

objects._comment: Place the prism on the 180-degree source beam. Its center and 49-degree yaw put the entry face about 0.20 m behind the collimator; this is near the minimum-deviation orientation and avoids total internal reflection across 400-700 nm.
Four pure-black triangles form a full-height slit centered on the 180-degree source normal. The baffle is 0.20 m from the emitter at x=-0.55 and about 0.20 m before the prism entry face.

A 2 m wide screen perpendicular to the 550 nm chief ray, 3 m beyond the prism. Predicted spectral coordinates along the screen are blue=-0.845 m, green=0 m, red=+0.296 m. Direct 180- and 225-degree source rays intersect at +2.702 m and -1.349 m, outside the screen.
